cases.purpose: Probe which namespace and kernel facilities a mapped user namespace provides to network fixtures.
cases.oracle: Raw capability probe output retained in evidence; carries no behavioral expectation.
cases.candidate_script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --net --mount --uts "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '
export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
echo "== id"; id
echo "== builtins"; for b in ip fw ping ss netstat netids pcap wg; do echo "$b: $(type -t $b)"; done
echo "== link types"
for t in dummy veth wireguard bridge vlan; do
  if [ $t = veth ]; then ip link add p0 type veth peer name p1; else ip link add x$t type $t; fi; echo "$t rc=$?"
done
echo "== iptables"; iptables -V; iptables -A OUTPUT -j DROP; echo "iptables-append rc=$?"; iptables -S
ip6tables -A OUTPUT -j DROP; echo "ip6tables-append rc=$?"
echo "== nft cli"; command -v nft; echo rc=$?
echo "== sysctl ping range"; echo "0 2000" > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ping_group_range; echo rc=$?; cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ping_group_range
echo "== packet sock"; python3 -c "
import socket
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET,socket.SOCK_RAW,socket.htons(3)); print(\"af_packet ok\")
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_RAW,socket.IPPROTO_ICMP); print(\"raw icmp ok\")
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM,socket.IPPROTO_ICMP); print(\"dgram icmp ok\")
"
echo "== tools"; ls /usr/sbin/tcpdump /usr/bin/ping /usr/bin/traceroute /usr/bin/ss /usr/sbin/ip /usr/bin/ip /usr/bin/wg /usr/sbin/conntrack 2>&1
echo "== tcpdump -D"; tcpdump -D 2>&1 | head
echo "== modules"; head -c 600 /proc/modules; ls /sys/module | tr "\n" " " | head -c 1500; echo
echo "== nf"; ls /proc/net | tr "\n" " "; echo; ls /proc/sys/net/netfilter 2>&1 | head
echo "== ip -V"; ip -V; cat /proc/net/protocols | head -30
echo "== wg genl"; ip link show xwireguard 2>&1
'
